Sometimes, usually shortly after lying down in bed and before falling asleep, I experience a sensation like my bed is shaking. Similar to if you set your bed up 10' from a set of train tracks.

I've experienced this once or twice a month for decades. Multiple beds, multiple locations. There's nothing environmental that could cause this (trains, earthquakes, wind, water hammer, HVAC, etc). I have experienced sleep paralysis in the past, and this is distinctly different (because I can still move, no sense of pressure, no visual or auditory hallucinations). It just feels like my bed is very noticeably shaking.

I've also tried placing my mattress directly on the floor to eliminate the possibility of bed frame weirdness, which made no difference. Though it does lean me towards suspecting that either I'm shaking or it's all in my head, because it's very hard to shake a heavy mattress and boxspring on thick carpet.
